title: How to plan a made-to-order wardrobe
excerpt: Start with the room dimensions and the items you need to store.
content:
Measure the available wall width, ceiling height and door clearance.

Make a list of the clothes, accessories and linens you use most. Plan the hanging space, shelves and drawers around that list.
seo_title: How to Plan a Made-to-Order Wardrobe
seo_description: Plan your wardrobe layout around your room measurements, storage needs and daily routine.
